title: Legibility Rules
description: Contrast tiers, the tier each palette color is held to as text, and the tiers each background must support in every variant

tiers.description: Named contrast tiers. `min` is the minimum WCAG 2 contrast ratio.

text.description: Palette color name -> the tier it is held to when used as text.

surfaces.description: Background palette color name -> tiers whose text colors must all pass on it in every variant.

fills.description: Accent colors used as solid backgrounds, the palette colors allowed as text on them, and the tier that text is held to.
